description: Ask The Librarian ? the long-term research library. Returns the answer PACKAGE: full relevant entries (findings, shelf articles, captured documents) with states, claim types, sources and disputes, open frontier threads, and holds_nothing=true with NO entries when the library has nothing. Reviewed background: it never overrides direct evidence you gather yourself.

patron.description: Optional: who is asking ? {did, name, runtime}. Anonymous when absent.

peers.description: Optional: also ask other libraries ? a peer's name, a group, or all; none = only this one. Their answers come back under peers[], each labelled with its library, never merged.

question.description: What you want the library's holdings on.

name: library_ask
